name: Hubei Qirobotics
summary: Hubei Qirobotics, known in Chinese as Qiling Robotics, develops humanoid and quadruped robots in Wuhan. Its work combines robot body design, motion control, perception and decision systems for inspection, emergency response, manufacturing, logistics and research. The company identifies research links with Huazhong University of Science and Technology and markets the Shennong humanoid and Chitu quadruped families.
